text:
Maria: Heads-up — NexusHealth POC hitting flakiness. TS SDK behind corporate SOCKS5 intermittently gets 407 Proxy Authentication Required, then our endpoints show 429 bursts. Demo failing.

Leo: which SDK version + logs?

Maria: ts-sdk@1.6.0. snippet:
```
09:01:02 INFO request=id=xyz start
09:01:02 WARN proxy auth=407
09:01:02 INFO retry=1 backoff=0
09:01:03 WARN proxy auth=407
09:01:03 ERROR resp=429 rate_limit
```
Proxy re-challenges creds; client retries immediately and amplifies traffic.

Anya: default retry initial backoff shouldn't be zero. quick mitigation: set `maxRetries:0` or bump `initialBackoffMs` + jitter. I can share code snippet.

Maria: customer wants retries but smarter behavior for 407. Can SDK treat 407 (from proxy agent) as transient-proxy with longer backoff and not count against rate limiter?

Anya: yes. Plan: add classification `transientProxy` for 407 when seen via proxyAgent, apply larger backoff and exclude from user rate metrics. I can PR a patch and publish RC.

ops-bot: current rate snapshot: window=60s quota=120, observed=310 during churn.

Leo: ops can do a temporary quota bump for trial — request created.

Maria: timeline? need stable demo in 24h.

Anya: will open branch `fix/ts-proxy-retries`, push RC in ~2h with test harness simulating SOCKS5 reauth. will include snippet on how to disable retries immediately.

security: note for security FAQ: recommend CONNECT tunneling and advise that proxy re-auth can affect retries/streaming.

Maria: thanks — I'll relay to NexusHealth infra and schedule retest when RC live. :white_check_mark:
